status_note: Reproduces on Polars 2.1.0, the latest release; `is_fallible_top_level` was unchanged on main on 2026-11-04 (35a2cb73). No upstream issue: [#22284](https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/22284) fixed the class for strict casts, and [#28521](https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/28521) (open) is a strict `strptime` pushed into a Parquet scan.
title: Predicate pushdown merges a filter on `str.to_integer` into the one before, which then raises
summary: Predicate pushdown merges a later filter into an earlier one unless the later predicate is fallible, and the fallible list (`is_fallible_top_level`, crates/polars-plan/src/plans/aexpr/mod.rs) holds strict casts, `list.get`/`arr.get` without `null_on_oob`, `replace_strict`, decimal and truncating arithmetic and strict `strptime`. `str.to_integer(strict=True)` raises on text that is not an integer, and it is missing from the list.

So `filter(s != 'x').filter(s.str.to_integer() == 1)` becomes one `FILTER (s != 'x') & (s.str.to_integer() == 1)`. `&` evaluates both sides on every row, so the parse runs on the row the first filter removes and raises. With predicate pushdown off, the query returns the row. Other raising parsers outside the list (`str.to_decimal`, `str.json_decode`, strict temporal parsers other than `strptime`) are the same class; not probed.
repro:
import polars as pl
lf = pl.LazyFrame({"s": ["1", "x"]})
q = lf.filter(pl.col("s") != "x").filter(pl.col("s").str.to_integer() == 1)
q.collect()  # ComputeError: strict integer parsing failed for 1 value(s): ["x"]
q.collect(engine="streaming")  # the same error
q.collect(optimizations=pl.QueryOptFlags(predicate_pushdown=False)).rows()  # [('1',)]
print(q.explain())
# FILTER (col("s") != "x") & (col("s").str.to_integer([dyn int: 10]) == 1)
handling: sverify collects every translated plan with `predicate_pushdown=False` (`sverify_polars.engine`), so its plans keep their filter order. The fix upstream is to add `str.to_integer(strict=True)` and the other raising string parsers to `is_fallible_top_level`.
found_by: the Polars characterization reverse pass (2026-11-04): each open fact checked against the source, docstrings and user guide at py-2.1.0 and Polars's own tests, with light probes on both engines; the source reading of predicate pushdown for polars-exec-predicate-pushdown, then a manual repro

checked.note: Repro on both engines, with and without predicate pushdown (Polars 2.1.0, macOS arm64, POLARS_IDEAL_MORSEL_SIZE=64). Source at py-2.1.0: crates/polars-plan/src/plans/aexpr/mod.rs#L294-L355 (the fallible list), crates/polars-plan/src/plans/aexpr/function_expr/strings.rs#L49-L50 and #L262-L263 (`ToInteger`, a plain elementwise function), crates/polars-plan/src/plans/optimizer/predicate_pushdown/mod.rs#L266-L300 (a filter's predicate is pushed into the filter below). Main at 35a2cb73 (2026-11-04, `gh api repos/pola-rs/polars/contents/crates/polars-plan/src/plans/aexpr/mod.rs?ref=main`): `is_fallible_top_level` at L298-L360 has the same arms, with no `ToInteger`. Duplicate search (`gh issue list --repo pola-rs/polars --state all --search`) for "to_integer predicate pushdown", "str.to_integer filter", "predicate pushdown strict parsing failed", "strict integer parsing failed filter", "fallible predicate pushdown", "is_fallible", "predicate pushdown raises filtered rows", "to_integer strict filter error", "filter pushdown cast error rows removed", "str.to_decimal filter" and "predicate pushdown error string parse": no matching issue. Related: #22284 (closed: strict casts pushed down, the fix that added the list), #28521 (open: a fallible `strptime` pushed into `scan_parquet`).
